Yes, you should get the full $59 back. Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any benefits. You renewed 5 days ago, so you have about 9 days left in the window, and you haven't ordered anything since.

- **Benefits:** Make sure you haven't used any other Plus benefit, such as a member-priced item, free shipping or returns, a 90-day guarantee claim, or early access to a rare plant drop. Using one would mean no refund.
- **Where the money goes:** The refund goes back to your original payment method. Once issued, cards take **5-10 business days** and digital wallets **3-5 business days**.
- **If the window passes:** After 14 days, or if you've used a benefit, there's no refund. Your benefits would continue to the end of the paid year.

My policy excerpts don't say where to cancel Leafy Plus, so I can't point you to a specific page. If you can't find it, I can escalate this to a Support Lead. It would help to cancel within the next 9 days.
